Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.4.0.9999

New features - Add a min_epochs parameter to early stopping, so that training runs for at least that many epochs before it can stop early (#36). - Start the bias of the output layer at the log-odds of the outcome rate in the training data, controlled by initOutputBias in setEstimator() and on by default. Models with rare outcomes no longer spend their first epochs lowering all predictions to the outcome rate, which with few batches per epoch let early stopping end training before the model ranked patients. This removes most of the instability in ResNet learning curves. It applies to models with a single-logit linear head, and not to the learning rate search. - Add gradClipNorm and deterministic to setEstimator(). gradClipNorm limits the norm of the gradients at each optimizer step, and several values are tuned as hyperparameters. deterministic makes PyTorch use only deterministic algorithms, so that training on a GPU with the same seed and data gives the same model. Both could only be set by editing the estimator settings by hand, and deterministic training then stayed on for later fits in the same session. - setRealMLP() takes estimatorSettings like the other model settings, so RealMLP’s learning rate, batch size, epochs, seed, early stopping, gradClipNorm and deterministic can be set and tuned. The default keeps the paper’s training settings. A scheduler is ignored with a warning, because RealMLP follows its own learning rate schedule. learningRate = "auto" works too: the final model starts from the rate the learning rate finder chose, which is now recorded as baseLR in the learning schedule. - Add a curvature argument to setCustomEmbeddingModel() for Poincare embeddings trained in a ball whose curvature is not -1. HypLL, which OHDSI/context uses, applies softplus to its curvature parameter, so its default of 1, when not trained, is a curvature of about -1.313.

Bug fixes - Avoid a segfault in batched matrix multiplication on Ubuntu 26.04. On Linux, torch is now imported with RTLD_DEEPBIND so that it does not call the system OpenBLAS, which has a crash in cblas_sgemm_batch. This is a temporary workaround until distributions ship the OpenBLAS fix. A startup message explains the risk if torch was already imported before the package loaded (#191). - Normalize custom embedding concept IDs for Polars 2 (#189). - Restore the weights of the best epoch after training. Checkpoints shared storage with the live model, so cross-validation predictions came from the last epoch. - Select the automatic learning rate within each fold on training data only, so that held-out outcomes no longer influence it. - Invalidate the training cache when the data, outcomes, folds, feature mapping, estimator settings, tuning metric, or the contents of finetuning and custom embedding files change, not only the parameter grid. Caches from earlier versions are recomputed. - Use the tuning metric and direction requested through hyperparameterSettings when selecting hyperparameters and trimming the cache. Its search, sampleSize, randomSeed and generator settings are not used, and a warning now says so; the search is set in the model settings. - Give tied positive and negative predictions half credit in the AUC used for early stopping and epoch selection. - Clear gradients between learning rate finder trials. - Handle a loss minimum within the first few learning rate finder steps. It failed with an argmin error, or picked a rate from beyond the minimum. - Train the final model when the data is smaller than one batch, instead of silently returning an untrained model. - Score validation data whose last batch holds a single patient, which failed with a zero-dimensional tensor error. - Report training and validation loss per observation when the last batch is incomplete. - Keep patients without any retained covariates when training and predicting, and raise an error if predictions do not match the cohort. - Pass the beta2 setting of RealMLP to the optimizer. AdamW used its default of 0.999 instead of RealMLP’s 0.95, so RealMLP results change. - Assign custom embeddings to the right covariates. Vectors were shifted to the preceding column, and depended on the order of the embeddings file. A concept with more than one vector in the file is now an error. - Make predictions independent of the padded sequence width for custom embedding models, RealMLP with mean aggregation and convolutional positional encodings. - Compute time token gaps in days from the time reference: its timePart and timeInterval for temporal sequence covariates, or the start day of each time window for covariates with explicit windows. Raise an error if neither is available. - Leave frozen RealMLP layers unchanged during data-dependent initialization. - Use the requested sigma in TemporalPE when it is not learnable. It was applied as exp(sigma), so the default of 1 acted as 2.72. - Add the trainable offsets of PoincareEmbeddings in the tangent space at the origin. For the Transformer and RealMLP they were combined with the mapped vectors by Mobius addition, which is defined for points inside the ball, not for tangent vectors. - Check that Poincare embeddings are finite and inside the ball. Vectors outside it passed through without being mapped, and vectors on its boundary became infinite. Compute the log map accurately near the boundary and for small curvatures, and reject trainable ball coordinates, which a Euclidean optimizer can move outside the ball. - Apply the projection of custom embeddings, used when the embeddings file has another dimension than the model, to custom features only. Its bias was added once per patient for ResNet and MLP, and to every padding and regular feature for the Transformer and RealMLP. - Leave the batch given to custom embeddings unchanged. Its custom features were set to zero, so RealMLP lost them in data-dependent initialization. - Load custom embedding files saved from GPU tensors, and reject Poincare embeddings too close to the boundary of the ball to be mapped in their precision. - Give custom embedding vectors to binary covariates only. A numeric covariate whose concept was in the embeddings file, such as a measurement value, got the concept’s vector and lost its value. - Name the combinations of dimToken and numHeads that are not divisible in the error of setTransformer(). It pasted the two vectors element by element, so it could name a combination that is divisible. - Stop with a clear error when fitEstimator() gets training data without a CovariateData object, instead of an error from deep inside the data mapping. - Predict with models loaded by loadPlpModel() when the data store analysisId as doubles. The saved covariate reference comes back from CSV with integer IDs, and joining it to the data’s analysis reference failed with a polars SchemaError. - Continue the hyperparameter search after a combination runs out of GPU memory, and free that combination’s memory first. Since torch 2.5 the error was not recognized, so the search stopped. The cleanup could not free memory that the error’s traceback still referred to, and instead, when more than 3 GB stayed allocated, emptied the storage of every CUDA tensor, including those still in use. - Switch early stopping off when earlyStopping has useEarlyStopping = FALSE. The setting was never read, so training still stopped early. - Reject model settings in which any value is out of range. The checks only failed when every value was, so dropout = c(-1, 0.5) passed. Dropout must now also be below 1. - Reject an unknown hyperParamSearch. Any value other than "random", such as a misspelling, ran the full grid. - Fine-tune models trained with custom embeddings, and RealMLP models (#198). The fine-tuner rebuilt the network without its custom embeddings, so the saved weights did not fit, and RealMLP had no reset_head(). - Keep the defaults of the temporal settings that a partial temporalSettings list leaves out. A partial list had timeTokens = FALSE, while the argument’s default has TRUE. Unknown names, such as time_tokens, are now an error; they were passed on next to the default. - Pass positional encoding options written in camelCase, such as kernelSize, to the encoding. Options an encoding does not take were dropped without a message, and now give a warning. - Reject tokenAggregation = "mean" with paperMode = TRUE in setRealMLP(). RealMLP sums the tokens in paper mode, so it silently replaced the setting. - Use the slopes of the ALiBi paper in ALiBiPE. A wrong formula gave other slopes for every number of heads but 4, for example 2^-3 to 2^-24 instead of 2^-1 to 2^-8 for 8 heads, and numbers of heads that are not a power of two failed. Saved models keep the slopes they were trained with. - Build ResLayer without dropout, which failed in forward. - Let the learning rate finder use the model’s own loss and label smoothing, as training does. It failed for RealMLP in paper mode, which has two outputs. - Record the hyperparameter settings given to fitEstimator() in the model design, instead of PatientLevelPrediction’s defaults.

Removed - Remove settings that no function of the package sets, and that could only be reached by editing the model or estimator settings by hand. Models fitted with the package’s own settings train and predict exactly as before. - Remove RealMLP’s wide branch: a linear model added to the network’s logit, with coefficient files to start it from, freezing of either part, an L1 penalty, weighting by the linear model’s uncertainty, and starting the whole model from a file. It is kept on the branch archive/realmlp-wide-branch. - Remove the concat_num, token_aggregation and numerical bias options of ResNet and the MLP, and the concatenate numeric embedding mode, which only concat_num used. - Remove the optimizer parameter groups of ResNet and the MLP. With their default factors they trained exactly like a single group. - Remove parallel data loading workers, input fingerprints, batch diagnostics, the previous_epochs epoch offset and an unused prefix setting. - Remove code that could not work: the plpData branch of predictDeepEstimator(), the numericalIndex branch of the dataset creation, convert_to_long(), and extras/example_plp5.R, which called functions that do not exist. Also remove the placeholder scheduler of setRealMLP(), which RealMLP’s learning rate schedule bypassed. - Move RealMLP’s own training settings out of the estimator settings: label smoothing, the learning rate multipliers and the data-dependent initialization settings are model parameters, and the schedules, AdamW’s betas and eps and the weight decay of biases belong to the RealMLP model. RealMLP trains as before. Estimator settings edited by hand to change them no longer have an effect. - Remove the retry of the optimizer without betas and eps when it failed. Options that a model gives the optimizer, such as RealMLP’s betas, are now passed only to optimizers that take them, and the others give a warning. - Remove the second way that ResNet and the MLP pooled custom embeddings, which summed the tokens and divided by their number. They now take the mean of the tokens like the other models, so predictions of saved custom embedding models change only by rounding.

Deprecated - The device argument of setRealMLP(). Use estimatorSettings = setEstimator(device = ).

Runtime and compatibility - Require Python 3.11 or newer. Python 3.10 reached end-of-life in October 2026, and duckdb 2.0.0 requires Python 3.11. - Require PatientLevelPrediction 6.6.0 or newer, which added tuning metrics. - Models trained with custom embeddings, RealMLP mean aggregation, time tokens, convolutional positional encodings or a fixed TemporalPE sigma compute their inputs differently now. Predictions from such saved models change, so retrain them. - Poincare embeddings with vectors outside the ball are now an error, also when predicting with a model saved by an earlier version. - Drop the nvidia-ml-py Python dependency. - Stop registering r_to_py() and py_to_r() methods for data frames for the whole R session. Once the package was loaded, every data frame that reticulate converted became a polars DataFrame instead of a pandas one, also in other packages and in users’ own code. The package now converts its own data frames.

Documentation and CI - Add an Ubuntu 26.04 CI job and a regression test for batched matrix multiplication. - Stop pinning Python duckdb on macOS CI, because version 1.5.2 cannot read files written by R duckdb 2.0.0. - Update tlmgr before installing LaTeX packages in the R-devel CI job. - Opt into the Eunomia integration tests with DPLP_RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true, separately from the Python tests (DPLP_RUN_PYTHON_TESTS=true). Running Python tests no longer downloads Eunomia and fits a model before the first test. Most tests now use PatientLevelPrediction’s simulated data; only the runPlp() checks on real data, the result uploads and the temporal Transformer test need Eunomia. - Check the Python backend with ruff in CI. - Measure test coverage on one CI job instead of all three Linux jobs, and add coverage of the Python backend, which covr cannot see. - Document the 12 positional encodings and their options in the temporal transformer vignette.

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.4.0

New features - Add hyperparameter tuning support for RealMLP.

Bug fixes - Keep temporal dataset feature_ids, feature_values, and time_ids aligned when multiple features share the same time ID.

Documentation and CI - Refresh RealMLP examples for current grid/random tuning behavior. - Add a dedicated temporal transformer vignette. - Update CI and installation guidance to validate the recommended Python environment with Python 3.14 and torch 2.12.1. - Pin Python duckdb to 1.5.2 on macOS CI to avoid intermittent shutdown segfaults. - Limit push-triggered R CMD checks to develop and main while keeping pull request checks enabled for all branches. - Refresh vignette wording and examples for current runtime guidance.

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.3.0

New features - Add core RealMLP support for tabular deep learning, including paper-style numeric embeddings, schedules, and data-dependent initialization (PR #171) - Add dropout support to TemporalPE and test coverage for positional-encoding dropout behavior (PR #165)

Bug fixes - Replace deprecated pynvml with nvidia-ml-py (PR #167, closes #166) - Improve expand-component handling and add regression tests (PR #164) - Fix estimator seed casting, prediction shaping, and custom-embedding / Poincare model paths for current torch and reticulate behavior (PR #171)

Runtime and compatibility - Relax the torch requirement to torch>=2.7,<3 and validate against torch==2.10.0 in stable CI lanes (PR #171) - Add a Python 3.10 compatibility lane using the latest available torch (PR #171) - Clean torchinductor_runner artifacts during R CMD check (PR #171)

Documentation and CI - Update installation guidance to recommend uv and Python 3.12 (PR #171) - Update GitHub Actions checks to use Python 3.12 by default and fix Windows torch installation handling (PR #171) - Update pkgdown link checking for current lychee CLI behavior (PR #171)

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.2.0

  • [Feature] Add positional encodings that use timeId (PR #154):
    • SinusoidalPE: Absolute sinusoidal positional embeddings using
    • LearnablePE: Learnable absolute positional embeddings
    • TapePE: Time-absolute Positional Encodings (tAPE)
    • RotaryPE: Rotary position embeddings (RoPE)
    • RelativePE: Relative positional embeddings (RPE)
    • EfficientRPE: Efficient relative positional embeddings (eRPE)
    • TemporalPE: Combines an absolute temporal embedding and a semantic one
    • StochasticConvPE: Relative learnable positional embedding (convSPE)
    • HybridRoPEconvPE: Combines RoPE and convSPE
    • TUPE: Transformer with learnable positional encoding (TUPE)
    • ALiBiPE: Attention with linear biases (ALiBi)
  • [Feature] Use py_require from reticulate to manage python dependencies and update min requirements (PR #150)
  • [Internal] Refactor transformer/dataset/embedding classes to use the same code whether temporal or not (PR #147)
  • [Feature] Use train/validation split for model selection instead of cross validation (PR #145)
  • [Feature] Temporal transformer added which supports RoPE and time tokens (PR #147)
  • [Feature] Temporal data processing added (PR #147)
  • [CI] Use uv for python in github actions (PR #136)
  • [Feature] Add an option to use torch compile (PR #133)
  • [Feature] More efficient conversions from polars to torch in dataset processing (PR #133)
  • [CI] Automatically detect broken links in docs using github actions
  • [Feature] Initialize models with embeddings, including Poincare (PR #125 and PR #130)
  • [Feature] Model initialization made more flexible with classes (PR #124)

DeepPatientLevelPrediction 2.1.0

  • Added basic transfer learning functionality. See vignette(“TransferLearning”)
  • Add a gpu memory cleaner to clean cached memory after out of memory error
  • The python module torch is now accessed through an exported function instead of loading the module at package load
  • Added gradient accumulation. Studies running at different sites using different hardware can now use same effective batch size by accumulating gradients.
  • Refactored out the cross validation from the hyperparameter tuning
  • Remove predictions from non-optimal hyperparameter combinations to save space
  • Only use html vignettes
  • Rename MLP to MultiLayerPerceptron
